slides.say: Purity bans changing things that existed before render. But changing what you just created? Totally fine.
This creates a new array during render, then pushes twelve cups into it. That is a mutation, but a local one.

slides.text: No code outside TeaGathering ever sees the array change. That is "local mutation".
slides.say: No code outside this component can ever see it happen. React calls it local mutation, your component’s little secret.

slides.text: Same push on an array made outside the component? A huge problem.
slides.say: But if the array were created outside the component, the exact same push would be a huge problem.
